summary: EmArcy Records is a jazz record label founded in 1954 by Mercury Records. The note states it is today a European jazz label owned by Universal Music Group. Its name is a phonetic spelling of "MRC", the initials for Mercury Record Company.
one_line: EmArcy Records is a jazz label founded by Mercury Records in 1954, now a European jazz label owned by Universal Music Group.
key_facts: EmArcy Records is a jazz record label.
EmArcy Records was founded in 1954 by Mercury Records.
EmArcy Records is today a European jazz label.
EmArcy Records is owned by Universal Music Group.
The name EmArcy is a phonetic spelling of "MRC".
MRC stands for the initials of Mercury Record Company.
